evidence.detail: Ad 1459327 for the same unit, 10 Hanover Square #21P, a studio, asked $3,100 from 2015-01-29 until 2015-02-18, the day this ad went on the market asking $31,025 (export responses 118 and 127).

note: The ad gives $31,025 in each of its records.

evidence.detail: Ad 2384921 for the same unit, 234 East 52nd Street #A, a one-bedroom, asked $3,150 from 2018-08-07 until it rented, so through 2018-08-20, the day this ad went on the market asking $28,875 (export response 430).
Ad 2485003 for the same unit, a one-bedroom with the same text, asked $3,211 on 2018-08-08, $3,150 on 2018-08-10 and $3,066 on 2018-08-15 (export response 458).

note: $28,875 is ten times $2,887.50, the net effective rent of $3,150 with one month free on a 12-month lease, so the recorded ask reads as that rent without its decimal point.

evidence.detail: Ad 2552463 for the same unit, 335 East 54th Street #4F, a one-bedroom, went on the market the same day asking $28,000, then asked $2,800 on 2018-10-18, then $2,700 and $2,695 (export response 474).
Ads 2451254 and 2510968 for the same unit, a one-bedroom, asked $2,850 on 2018-07-11 and 2018-09-04 (export responses 449 and 466).

note: The ad gives $28,000 in each of its records.

evidence.detail: Ad 1568026 for the same unit, 1689 First Avenue #2, a three-bedroom, asked $3,750 from 2016-04-28 until it rented in August 2016, so on 2016-05-16, the day this ad asked $37,500 (export response 2286).
Ad 1792235 for the same unit went on the market the same day asking $37,500 and changed its ask to $3,750 that day (export response 2375).

note: The ad gives $37,500 in each of its records.

evidence.quote: For just $2150 a month with no brokers fee

evidence.detail: The recorded ask of $21,545 is a tenfold typo: the ad's text asks $2,150. No other ad of 992 Bedford Avenue #1A gives an ask, so nothing beyond the ad's own words backs a set.

note: Ad text: "For just $2150 a month with no brokers fee". Ad 2139816, 992 Bedford Avenue #1, a studio with the same description apart from its price, asked $2,150 on 2017-07-06 (export response 4492). Its unit differs, so it backs no set.
